evals.prompt: I have a self-hosted Trigger.dev v4 instance running at trigger.mycompany.com. How do I set up a new Node.js project to use it? I need to configure both dev and production environments.
evals.expected_output: Should cover: login -a with URL, profiles, npx trigger init, trigger.config.ts, TRIGGER_SECRET_KEY formats (tr_dev_xxx, tr_prod_xxx), TRIGGER_API_URL, .env setup

assertions.text: Shows both tr_dev_xxx and tr_prod_xxx key formats

evals.prompt: Write a Trigger.dev task that processes image uploads. It should validate the input with Zod, retry up to 5 times on failure, use a queue with max 3 concurrent executions, and track progress via metadata.
evals.expected_output: Should produce working TypeScript with schemaTask or task+zod, retry config, queue(), metadata.set for progress, proper exports

evals.prompt: I need to configure my Trigger.dev project to use Prisma for database access and FFmpeg for video processing. Show me the complete trigger.config.ts.
evals.expected_output: Should show defineConfig with both prismaExtension and ffmpeg in build.extensions array

evals.prompt: Build a Trigger.dev pipeline that classifies incoming customer support emails, routes complex ones to GPT-4o and simple ones to GPT-4o-mini, processes them in parallel batches, and pauses for human review on flagged content.
evals.expected_output: Should combine routing pattern, parallelization with batch.triggerByTaskAndWait, and wait.forToken for human approval

assertions.text: Uses batch or parallel execution pattern

evals.prompt: I want to show real-time progress of a long-running Trigger.dev task in my Next.js React app. The task processes a batch of items and I want a progress bar. How do I set this up?
evals.expected_output: Should cover: auth.createPublicToken, useRealtimeRun or useRealtimeTaskTrigger hook, metadata for progress, @trigger.dev/react-hooks

assertions.text: Includes auth token creation (createPublicToken or createTriggerPublicToken)

evals.prompt: Set up GitHub Actions to deploy my Trigger.dev tasks. I have a self-hosted instance and want to deploy to staging on develop branch pushes and production on main branch pushes.
evals.expected_output: Should show GitHub Actions YAML with branch conditions, TRIGGER_ACCESS_TOKEN and TRIGGER_API_URL secrets, deploy --env staging/production

assertions.text: Has branch conditions for staging and production

evals.prompt: I manage two Trigger.dev instances - one on cloud and one self-hosted. How do I set up CLI profiles to switch between them easily?
evals.expected_output: Should cover: login with --profile, list-profiles, switch command, using profiles with dev and deploy

assertions.text: Shows using profile with dev or deploy command

evals.prompt: I want to trigger a Trigger.dev task via MCP, wait for it to complete, and if it fails, get the error details. What MCP tools do I use?
evals.expected_output: Should show: get_current_worker to check schema, trigger_task, wait_for_run_to_complete, get_run_details for errors

evals.prompt: My self-hosted Trigger.dev v4 runs are stuck in QUEUED status and never start executing. The supervisor container is running but tasks just sit there.
evals.expected_output: Should check: worker token, supervisor logs, Docker memory, container health, suggest restart supervisor

assertions.text: Mentions Docker or container health check

evals.prompt: Show me a complete example of a Trigger.dev scheduled task that syncs data from an external API every hour with batch processing and error handling.
evals.expected_output: Should show schedules.task with cron, batch processing pattern, retry/error handling, complete working code
